name: ProductCool

sources.title: Homepage — active directory, 'Latest Submissions' dated today; Submit Product nav
Submit route — client-rendered form behind sign-in (/auth/signin?callbackUrl=/submit)
submit.productcool.com resolves to DirSubmit — a paid done-for-you service ($59/$99/$199 one-time, 60-240+ directory submissions)

requirements: Broad scope: tools, products, apps, repos across many categories (Productivity, Developer Tools, AI, Extensions, etc.)
Listings show a submission date and a score; 'Featured' slots exist as a paid/promoted band
preparation: An account on productcool.com (auth providers not verified statically)
Product name, URL, tagline, description, logo, category/tags
Good landing-page metadata — many entries appear metadata-scraped (GitHub repos listed directly)
workflow: Approved entries land in 'Latest Submissions' with a dated listing and score; Featured band is separate
watchFor: The top banner and submit.productcool.com subdomain push DirSubmit, a paid mass-submission service ($59–$199) — don't confuse it with the free on-site listing
Site is JS-heavy (submit page renders 'Loading…' without JS)
Directory contains scraped-looking entries (e.g., tensorflow, vscode auto-listed) — editorial bar is low
Simplified-Chinese UI strings in page shell — small indie operation
countsAsLive: The product appears under Latest Submissions / category pages with a public product page on productcool.com
unknowns: Whether any payment is required inside the submit form itself
